text: {"lessons":["A few periods of gains or losses do not tell me what prices will do next; I should not trade based on recent price moves.","Selling Stock C after a gain and buying other stocks does not guarantee a better outcome; I should judge trades by their effect on the whole portfolio, not by a position’s average cost.","Losses bother me more than equal gains please, so I should watch that loss aversion does not drive reactive decisions and keep risk consistent with my plan."]}
